intro: An end-to-end production workspace for AI-generated short dramas. From script input to structured storyboarding, consistency management, shot preparation, video generation, and export.

steps.title: 🔁 Frontend OpenAPI client and type generation
Start
steps.code:
cp deploy/compose/.env.example deploy/compose/.env
docker compose --env-file deploy/compose/.env -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml up --build

steps.title: Backend
steps.code:
cd backend
cp .env.example .env
uv sync
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

steps.title: Frontend
steps.code:
cd front
pnpm install
pnpm dev

zh.what: 面向 AI 短剧的端到端生产工作台：剧本进去，结构化分镜、角色场景素材、成片出来，前后端一体，可用 Docker 部署。

steps.title: 准备配置
steps.desc: 复制环境变量模板成 .env，填好模型和存储相关配置。
steps.code:
cp deploy/compose/.env.example deploy/compose/.env
docker compose --env-file deploy/compose/.env -f deploy/compose/docker-compose.yml up --build

steps.title: 起后端
steps.desc: 进 backend 目录安装依赖并启动服务。
steps.code:
cd backend
cp .env.example .env
uv sync
uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

steps.title: 起前端
steps.desc: 进 front 目录装依赖跑开发服务，浏览器打开就能用。
steps.code:
cd front
pnpm install
pnpm dev
